chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled regarding a mukatabah who died after having paid most of what was due from her, and she had given birth to a child during her contract.

So he ruled concerning her child that a portion of him be freed equal to the portion of her that had been freed, and a portion of him remain in bondage equal to the portion of her that had remained in bondage.

key_terms.مُكَاتَبَةٍ: a female slave under a contract of manumission
key_terms.يُرَقَّ: to remain in bondage or be treated as enslaved

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the child of a mukatabah who dies before completing her contract of manumission?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام concerning the child of a mukatabah who died before fully completing her manumission contract. The child's status follows the mother's proportional degree of freedom and bondage at the time, establishing a precise juridical principle in rulings related to mukatabah.
